name: shophub
description: ShopHub - mid-level E-Commerce app built as a modular microservices system (gateway + auth + product + cart + order) with React frontend.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix services/auth-service install && npm --prefix services/product-service install && npm --prefix services/cart-service install && npm --prefix services/order-service install && npm --prefix services/gateway install && npm --prefix frontend install
